svg.title: Throughput per scenario, latest run
svg.desc: Latest recorded run: 2026-11-13T05:47:39Z (commit 98ccf765). Requests per second at fixed concurrency; each panel has its own scale. A panel with a single bar is a scenario only that proxy runs (browser-check, or one the others skip). rate-limited and error-page count every response (429 and 502), not only 2xx. websocket counts echo round trips (a message each way) per second.
